xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4682: Fly remote: default image registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest does not exist

plan.title: Fly remote: default image registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest does not exist
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Both code paths that create Fly Machines (FlyProvider for pan start --remote, provisionFlyMachine for pan machines add-fly) default the image to registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest. The Fly registry is app-scoped and no app named pan-workspace exists, so that repository answers NAME_UNKNOWN and every machine create with no [remote.fly] image points at a missing image. pan remote setup also writes the dead literal into the operator's config.toml, and the add-fly help text, composer manifest and docs repeat it.
narratives.Proposal: Export DEFAULT_FLY_APP and defaultFlyImage(app) => `registry.fly.io/${app}:latest` from src/lib/remote/fly-provider.ts. FlyProvider's constructor and provisionFlyMachine both fall back to defaultFlyImage(resolved app) after an explicit --image and [remote.fly] image. pan remote setup stops seeding an image key. The add-fly --image help text, the regenerated composer manifest, cli/machines.mdx and docs/fly-provider.md name the derived default and push to registry.fly.io/pan-workspaces:latest. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4682.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not edit .github/workflows/build-workspace-image.yml (wrong APP_NAME, fly not on PATH, no FLY_API_TOKEN secret); that is PAN-4778.
- Do not add GitHub Actions secrets or push any image.
- Do not rewrite operators' existing config.toml files or treat the old literal registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest as unset in code.
- Do not make live Fly API calls.
- Do not rename the docker/pan-workspace/ folder or the default Fly app pan-workspaces.
- Do not edit historical PRDs (docs/prds/active/PAN-340-plan.md) or the PAN-4652/PAN-4296 live-verification sections of docs/fly-provider.md.
- Do not change the registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest fixture strings in tests/lib/remote/fly-api.test.ts.
- Do not change the explicit-override precedence: --image, then [remote.fly] image, then the default.

autoDecisions.summary: Default image is registry.fly.io/<resolved app>:latest, computed by one exported helper defaultFlyImage() in fly-provider.ts and used by both FlyProvider and provisionFlyMachine.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body names this fix; the Fly registry is app-scoped; provision.ts already duplicated FlyProvider's defaults, which is how the two could drift.

autoDecisions.summary: pan remote setup omits the image key from the [remote.fly] block it seeds instead of writing the new derived value.
autoDecisions.rationale: Writing any literal pins it; the setup output tells operators to edit app, and only an omitted image follows that edit.

autoDecisions.summary: The broken CI image-build workflow is split into sibling issue PAN-4778 and not touched here.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fixing APP_NAME alone does not make it pass (fly not on PATH, no FLY_API_TOKEN secret needs an operator), and workflow-file pushes need a credential with workflow scope, which would put this branch's push at risk.

autoDecisions.summary: No migration of configs that already hold registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest; the troubleshooting doc tells operators to delete that line.
autoDecisions.rationale: Silently treating a configured value as unset hides config from the operator; a documented one-line fix is explicit and reversible.

metadata.sizeJustification: Small bug fix: 5 items, about 10 files, 3 subsystems (remote provider, anywhere/fly provisioning, CLI + docs).

items.title: FlyProvider derives its default image from the resolved Fly app

expected_outputs: tests/lib/remote/fly-provider.test.ts passes including the new default-image cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/remote/fly-provider.ts, below DURABLE_MAX_RETRIES add `export const DEFAULT_FLY_APP = 'pan-workspaces';` and `export function defaultFlyImage(app: string): string { return `registry.fly.io/${app}:latest`; }` with the JSDoc from the PRD. In the FlyProvider constructor compute `const app = config.app ?? DEFAULT_FLY_APP;` first, set `app,` and `image: config.image ?? defaultFlyImage(app),`. Update the FlyProviderConfig.image JSDoc to name the default. In tests/lib/remote/fly-provider.test.ts: tighten the `image: expect.any(String)` assertion in 'calls ensureApp then createMachine' to 'registry.fly.io/test-app:latest'; add a case for createFlyProvider({}) → app pan-workspaces and image registry.fly.io/pan-workspaces:latest; add a case where an explicit image registry.fly.io/custom:v1 passes through; add a defaultFlyImage('my-app') unit case.

items.title: Given createFlyProvider({}) with no app or image, when createVm runs, then createMachine receives app 'pan-workspaces' and image 'registry.fly.io/pan-workspaces:latest'
Given createFlyProvider({ app: 'test-app' }), when createVm runs, then createMachine receives image 'registry.fly.io/test-app:latest'
Given createFlyProvider({ app: 'test-app', image: 'registry.fly.io/custom:v1' }), when createVm runs, then createMachine receives image 'registry.fly.io/custom:v1' unchanged
fly-provider.ts exports defaultFlyImage, which returns 'registry.fly.io/my-app:latest' for 'my-app', and `git grep -n "pan-workspace:latest" -- src/lib/remote` prints nothing
provisionFlyMachine defaults the image through defaultFlyImage(appName)

expected_outputs: provision.test.ts passes including the default-image and precedence cases

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In src/lib/anywhere/fly/provision.ts change `import type { FlyProvider } from '../../remote/fly-provider.js';` to `import { DEFAULT_FLY_APP, defaultFlyImage, type FlyProvider } from '../../remote/fly-provider.js';`, set `const DEFAULT_APP = DEFAULT_FLY_APP;`, delete `const DEFAULT_IMAGE = 'registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest';`, and change the createMachine image to `input.image ?? cfg.image ?? defaultFlyImage(appName)` using the existing `appName` variable (the one passed to ensureApp), never cfg.app. Keep vi.useFakeTimers() in the test file. Add tests: default image is 'registry.fly.io/overdeck-ws:latest' for the harness's flyConfig.app; input.image wins; with h.deps.flyConfig.image = 'registry.fly.io/y:2' and no input image the config image wins.

items.title: Given flyConfig { app: 'overdeck-ws' } with no image and no --image, when provisionFlyMachine runs, then createMachine receives image 'registry.fly.io/overdeck-ws:latest'

Given input { image: 'registry.fly.io/x:1' }, when provisionFlyMachine runs, then createMachine receives 'registry.fly.io/x:1'; given flyConfig.image 'registry.fly.io/y:2' and no input image, then it receives 'registry.fly.io/y:2'
`git grep -n "pan-workspace:latest" -- src/lib/anywhere` prints nothing and provision.ts no longer declares DEFAULT_IMAGE
pan remote setup stops seeding the dead image literal into config.toml

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In src/cli/commands/remote/setup.ts delete the `image: 'registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest',` line from the seeded remote.fly block, and change the closing hint `Make sure your Fly app exists and the pan-workspace image is built.` to `Make sure your Fly app exists and its image is pushed to registry.fly.io/<app>:latest.` Add tests/unit/cli/remote-setup.test.ts that mocks ../../../src/lib/config.js (loadConfigSync → {}, saveConfig spy), ../../../src/lib/remote/index.js (createFlyProvider → { isAuthenticated: () => Effect.succeed(true) }), child_process exec (callback with { stdout: '' }) and ora (spinner with start/succeed/warn no-ops), silences console.log, calls setupCommand(), and asserts the saved config.

`git grep -n "pan-workspace:latest" -- src/cli/commands/remote/setup.ts` prints nothing, and the setup output prints a hint naming registry.fly.io/<app>:latest

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Change the --image option description in src/cli/commands/machines-fly.ts (line 123) to 'Image (default: remote.fly.image, else registry.fly.io/<app>:latest)'. Run `npm run build:cli && npm run generate:slash-commands` (never against a stale dist) and commit the regenerated packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts in the same commit. In cli/machines.mdx change the --image table row (line 126) to: Image. Default: `[remote.fly] image`, else `registry.fly.io/<app>:latest` (the Fly registry is app-scoped).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5, steps 1-7, editing docs/fly-provider.md only: prerequisite bullet (line 32) names registry.fly.io/<app>:latest and keeps the #building-the-pan-workspace-image anchor; the example [remote.fly] block comments out the image line and says the default is registry.fly.io/<app>:latest because the registry is app-scoped; the config table's remote.fly.image default becomes registry.fly.io/<app>:latest; the Build and push block uses registry.fly.io/pan-workspaces:latest in docker build -t and docker push plus a sentence to substitute a custom app; the 'image tag must match' sentence describes the effective image; troubleshooting 'Image not found' gains a step telling operators who have registry.fly.io/pan-workspace:latest (seeded by pan remote setup before PAN-4682) to delete that line; the PAN-4295 live-run sentence (lines 488-490) says the default was fixed by PAN-4682. Do not edit the PAN-4652/PAN-4296 live-verification sections.

items.title: Given docs/fly-provider.md, when an operator follows the Build and push block, then it builds and pushes `registry.fly.io/pan-workspaces:latest` (both the `docker build -t` and the `docker push` lines name that reference)
The config field reference row for remote.fly.image shows the default `registry.fly.io/<app>:latest`, and the example [remote.fly] block has the image line commented out with that default explained
